title: Vortex Strawberry Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Strawberry Lime combines the ripe, juicy sweetness of Strawberry with the zesty, tangy notes of Lime. This flavour delivers a bright and lively vape, ideal for vapers seeking bold and refreshing fruit combinations. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Strawberry Lime offers smooth vapour production and rich flavour, perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. The nicotine salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making it an excellent choice for everyday vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are available in a convenient 10ml format, offering a more sustainable and cost-effective alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Strawberry Lime is a dynamic option for fruit-loving vapers.
